one Observe terminal frame per operation on an addressed document; JSON + generated manual

cli::run(args) -> (exit, stdout): help, descriptors, providers, open, panel, edit, verify; exit 0 pass, 1 failed/refused with JSON, 2 usage; R5: verify with no --expect-revision/--expect-name/--expect-visible is a usage error (exit 2) before the package is opened; edit --save OUT naming the input PACKAGE (same file after resolving paths) is a usage error unless --overwrite is given; manual, flags and DESCRIPTOR updated
examples/studio-harness.rs: thin forwarder; DESCRIPTOR with proven_by (claim -> test)

notes.desktop_window: DECISION PENDING (lead): a desktop window consumer needs eframe/winit, which tools/workspace-probe.rs forbids for every crate. Slice 1 is headless only and states `desktop_window_consumer` in not_proven in every report and in DESCRIPTOR.
notes.edge_gap: The harness may depend only on accord, folio, session, controls, observe. No direct chronicle/package edge is needed.
notes.appearance_values: chronicle has only name/visible properties; appearance controls are read-only projections (route none, reason no_chronicle_property).
notes.controls_use: panel is built only from hsk-studio-controls descriptors; the dead-control audit runs (7/7 consumed).
notes.fixture: tests/fixtures/demo.handshake (5099 bytes, revision 9) generated by session-consumer --demo.
notes.files_and_paths: The harness never picks a path: every path is a command-line argument. Tests that write files use TMP under a per-test directory (asserts it is not on C:, removed on drop); the scratch name now carries a per-test label so parallel tests never share it.
known_gaps: no RenderPort / visual capture (render engines are not dependencies; capability stays NOT_PROVEN)
no idempotency keys, grant/commit/job ports: the session runs standalone
edit sequence stops at the first failing edit; no multi-edit atomic batch
artboard and page-spread renames supported by chronicle but not exposed by the harness commands
stories and sequences are summarized but not editable
--save has no root restriction by design: the caller owns the destination (documented in the manual); only replacing the input needs --overwrite
hard links to the input are not detected by the --save guard (symlinks and path spellings are, via canonicalize)

remediation_R5.route: product failures fixed by commit c41b067; no gameplan step added; cargo test ran green first time on each tree (retry guard never fired); disk-wide build lock waits of 2-3 min are normal
